newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Health earns 41 mln yuan in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Health earns 41 mln yuan in 1996.

text.p: Shenzhen Health Mineral Water Co Ltd had net profits of 40.54 million yuan on turnover of 151.69 million in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.25 yuan in 1996, with net assets per share at 2.23 yuan, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the company's 1996 results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.
Health generated net profits of 22.56 million yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards, according to the firm's 1995 annual report.
Under Chinese accounting standards, the 1995 net profit was 23.33 million yuan, the report said.
The company proposed a cash payment of 0.118 yuan per share based on its 1996 profit, the exchange said.
Trading in the firm's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
